description: This file defines an internal class 'GlobalObjectTable_not_in_use' that manages a thread-local cache of document handles for PDF documents within the PdfSharp library. It includes methods for attaching and detaching documents, notifying other documents upon detachment, and maintains a list of document handles.

classes.name: GlobalObjectTable_not_in_use
classes.description: Provides a thread-local cache for large objects, managing document handles and notifying documents upon detachment.

methods.name: AttachDocument
methods.description: Adds a document handle to the internal list.

methods.name: DetachDocument
methods.description: Removes a document handle, notifies other documents about the detachment, and cleans up null references.
